name: Jiangxi Institute of Biological Products Inc.
summary: Jiangxi Institute of Biological Products Inc. manufactures and exports biological products including Tetanus Antitoxin and Veterinary Medicine. The company offers Antitoxin Formulations, Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, Equine Byproducts, essential oils, and plant extracts. It serves businesses in China and international markets. The company was founded in 1969 and is based in Ji'an, China. Jiangxi Institute of Biological Products Inc. is a subsidiary of Shenzhen Qianhai Tianzheng Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
